svg.title: Mineral processing operator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as mineral processing operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A tapered feed hopper sits above two separate crushing rollers and a small lower product chute. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
